issues.title: Connect the WEDOS-managed public subdomain after content acceptance
issues.question: Can documentation.lazurio.ai be associated with the Cloudflare Pages project and the required CNAME be published in WEDOS after the exact-head content gate?
issues.impact: The documentation can run on its immutable pages.dev deployment, but the canonical public URL and TLS readback remain incomplete until both provider sides agree on the hostname.
options: Associate the subdomain in Cloudflare Pages first, then publish the exact CNAME in WEDOS and verify TLS and canonical URLs.
Keep the reviewed pages.dev deployment as preview and defer the public hostname without changing the lazurio.ai nameservers.
Migrate the whole DNS zone only under a separate mail and DNS preservation plan; do not do this for the documentation launch alone.

issues.title: Select an external IT reader for the comprehension gate
issues.question: Who will read the first deployed preview without an introductory call and report what remains unclear?
issues.impact: Internal checks can prove consistency and source coverage but cannot prove that an unfamiliar IT administrator understands Lazurio in ten minutes. The first public release keeps this test as a production gate.
options: Choose one representative external IT administrator after the first readable preview exists.
Keep the release on preview until a suitable reader is available; do not substitute an internal author for the external comprehension test.

issues.title: Align the documentation lockup after the Lazurio logo direction is finalized
issues.question: Which final Lazurio lockup should the documentation header use after the in-progress product identity is approved?
issues.impact: The first release safely uses the text title and the approved favicon. It must not present a working lockup direction as final brand identity.
options: Keep the text title until the design-system owner publishes a final asset.
Adopt the approved asset in a later scoped visual update with browser parity checks.

issues.title: Activate the Organization module slot before Module Setup
issues.question: Will an authorized Organization reviewer approve the exact module registry entry so the documentation slot becomes active?
issues.impact: The repository and content can be prepared, but the canonical lazurio.module.v1 descriptor and Launchpad runtime remain fail-closed while the Organization registry reports planned_slot.
options: Approve and publish the reviewed Organization registry change, update the Organization primary checkout, then run lazurio module setup read-only and with --apply.
Leave the slot planned and keep the documentation repository undeployable from Launchpad. Do not create a hand-written descriptor that bypasses the Organization authority.

issues.title: Confirm availability of advanced GitHub secret-scanning modes
issues.question: Can non-provider pattern scanning and validity checks be enabled for this public repository under the current GitHub Organization plan and policy?
issues.impact: GitHub secret scanning, push protection, vulnerability alerts and Dependabot security updates are enabled. Provider readback still reports the two advanced secret-scanning modes as disabled, so their extra coverage is not currently part of the repository control set.
options: Enable the advanced modes if the Organization plan exposes them and verify provider readback.
Keep standard secret scanning and push protection as the enforced baseline and document the advanced modes as unavailable.
